sections.Profile:
The "Millionaire" pinball machine, released by Williams in 1987, features a casino theme with vibrant artwork and a mix of classic pinball elements. It includes three flippers, one ramp, and a two-ball multiball mode, providing engaging gameplay dynamics. The machine operates on the Williams System 11A hardware and has an alphanumeric display for scoring.
